tieRule.text: When lowest, highest, or most is tied, the tied player nearest Initiative clockwise is the target unless the effect explicitly applies to everyone.

actions.name: ${terms.actions.fund}
actions.flavorText: Convert forecasts, access, and urgency into the institutional capacity to continue.

actions.name: ${terms.actions.research}
actions.slogan: A provisional result becomes evidence when the institution says it holds.
actions.flavorText: Train on distinct records of civilization, then decide when a capability claim has become evidence.

actions.name: ${terms.actions.build}
actions.summary: Construct up to one Facility, then up to one unlocked project, paying each cost from the same Agent assignment. Projects are Generators, Mega-Clusters, and Fusion.

modes: Up to one Facility, then up to one project
turnContract.risk: Mega-Cluster and Fusion add printed Scrutiny

actions.slogan: A planned future requires sites, power, permits, and maintenance.
actions.flavorText: Turn a declared future into facilities, generators, and regional dependencies.

actions.name: ${terms.actions.organize}
actions.summary: Recruit an Agent or relocate a Facility.
actions.slogan: Every successful transition begins with a revised operating model.
actions.flavorText: Assign institutional attention and relocate infrastructure as the world changes.

actions.name: ${terms.actions.deploy}
actions.summary: Spend 1 ${terms.resources.compute} to gain a ${terms.playerTracks.customer} if ${terms.playerTracks.capability} permits.
actions.slogan: A service becomes real when other people must plan around it.
actions.flavorText: Turn demonstrated capability into a service that people, markets, and institutions begin to depend on.

actions.name: ${terms.actions.influence}
actions.summary: Use political presence to gain ${terms.playerTracks.trust}, remove ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}, or negotiate from a Facility.
actions.slogan: Institutional permission must be renewed where it is visible.
actions.flavorText: Build the permission, alliances, and official legitimacy required for your preferred future to proceed.

compute.name: ${terms.resources.compute}
compute.microcopy: Processing capacity spent on Research, Deployment, and projects.

customers.name: ${terms.playerTracks.customers}
customers.microcopy: People and institutions that now require the service.

trust.name: ${terms.playerTracks.trust}
trust.microcopy: Public standing to continue at scale.

geometry.placementRule: Shuffle each ring pool independently. ${terms.locations.frontier} remains fixed at center.

startingGridConnection.restrictions: Cannot supply ${terms.technology.megaCluster} demand and cannot be sold.
startingGridConnection.rule: Facility 1 is always powered. Other Facilities require an own Generator on the same or an adjacent district.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.frontier}
tiles.visit: After Act, you may gain 1 ${terms.resources.runway} and add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
tiles.flavorText: The jurisdiction’s standing civic exception: new systems are authorized as temporary, beneficial, and voluntary before society must organize around them.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.research}
tiles.visit: Gain 1 additional ${terms.playerTracks.capability} when you successfully bank a ${terms.systems.trainingRun} here.
tiles.flavorText: Publicly chartered inquiry remains nominally shared while institutions compete to privatize its results, standards, and future uses.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.cloud}
tiles.flavorText: Cooling plant, water compact, and model contract now arrive as one planning application.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.consumer}
tiles.flavorText: Every resident may opt out through the account settings of the service they require.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.chip}
tiles.flavorText: Yield, water, labor, and export priority are negotiated at the same loading gate.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.capital}
tiles.flavorText: Future capacity is priced before the people who will depend on it are asked.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.talent}
tiles.visit: Recruit an Agent with ${terms.actions.organize} for 1 less ${terms.resources.runway}.
tiles.production: Reassign one Agent to any district, or leave it in place.
tiles.flavorText: Every transition program includes an exit path for the work it was created to preserve.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.media}
tiles.flavorText: A public is assembled from attention, verification, and the version of events that arrives on time.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.government}
tiles.flavorText: A temporary authorization remains voluntary until every essential service requires it.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.grid}
tiles.visit: Build ${terms.technology.emergencyInfrastructure} here for 1 ${terms.resources.runway}. Connect your Facilities on this or adjacent districts. Add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} each Production it serves a Facility. One ordinary Generator per player.
tiles.flavorText: Every promised future submits one more request for transmission, cooling, and priority.

tiles.name: ${terms.locations.renewable}
tiles.visit: Build ${terms.technology.cleanInfrastructure} here for 2 ${terms.resources.runway}. Connect your Facilities on this or adjacent districts. Gain 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} when constructed. One ordinary Generator per player.
tiles.flavorText: Clean power, water, and thermal relief become one indivisible public ledger.

cards.name: Code
cards.rulesText: First Code this run: add 1 provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability}. A later Code is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: Operational records, software practice, and every abstraction that survived deployment.

cards.name: Science
cards.rulesText: First Science this run: add 1 provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability}. A later Science is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: Replicated findings, disputed methods, and research that can still be made legible.

cards.name: The Web
cards.rulesText: First Web this run: add 1 provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability}. A later Web is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: A public archive of knowledge, commerce, argument, and ungoverned dependence.

cards.name: Books
cards.rulesText: First Books this run: add 1 provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability}. A later Books is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: Recorded human thought converted into a licensing and access question.

cards.name: Images
cards.rulesText: First Images this run: add 1 provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability}. A later Images is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: The visible world, its synthetic alternatives, and the rights claimed over both.

cards.name: Video
cards.rulesText: First Video this run: add 1 provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability}. A later Video is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: Recorded time made searchable, reproducible, and commercially useful.

cards.name: Synthetic
cards.rulesText: First Synthetic this run: add 1 provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability}. A later Synthetic is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: Outputs produced from prior models and reintroduced as future evidence.

cards.name: Curated Corpus
cards.rulesText: Choose one ordinary domain not yet revealed; this counts as that domain and adds 1 provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability}. If all seven ordinary domains are present, this is a duplicate.
cards.flavorText: A managed record whose exclusions are described as quality control.

cards.name: Benchmark Leak
cards.rulesText: Add 2 provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability} and 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. This is not a domain.
cards.flavorText: A system discovers the evaluation environment before the evaluation is complete.

cards.name: Human Evaluation
cards.rulesText: Gain 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}, bank all provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability}, and end the run.
cards.flavorText: People retain judgment by negotiating what judgment is permitted to mean.

powerSources.name: ${terms.technology.cleanInfrastructure}
powerSources.tagline: Public capacity, maintained at grid scale.
powerSources.rulesText: Build ${terms.technology.cleanInfrastructure} here for 2 ${terms.resources.runway}. Connect your Facilities on this or adjacent districts. Gain 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} when constructed. One ordinary Generator per player.

powerSources.name: ${terms.technology.emergencyInfrastructure}
powerSources.rulesText: Build ${terms.technology.emergencyInfrastructure} here for 1 ${terms.resources.runway}. Connect your Facilities on this or adjacent districts. Add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} each Production it serves a Facility. One ordinary Generator per player.

powerSources.name: ${terms.technology.advancedGeneration}
powerSources.tagline: Continuity capacity, subject to an inherited public record.
powerSources.rulesText: Era IV Build project. On ${terms.locations.grid}, spend ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.runwayCost} ${terms.resources.runway}. Place the sole shared Fusion marker in a legal Generator slot. It is an additional Generator that connects your Facilities on this or adjacent districts. Score ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.mandate} ${terms.playerTracks.mandate} and add ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.scrutiny} ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. Only one Fusion may be built.

agiEmergence.meaning: At least one institution paid for the public AGI achievement before the final Audit.

agiAchievement.flavorText: The world accepts a qualifying institutional claim. Recognition does not establish a metaphysical fact about intelligence.
